•
Ensure that all design activities adhere to the company's quality standards, best practices, and regulatory requirements.

•
Conduct regular reviews and audits to verify compliance with established guidelines and specifications.

•
Support the in-house Costing Team in cost management, change management and contract administration,

•

•

Prepare and present comprehensive project reports and presentations to management and stakeholders.

Job Title: Delivery Station Supervisor

Location: Cambridge
Reports to: Delivery Station Manager

Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive and hands-on Delivery Station Supervisor to take a leading role in the day to day running of the depot.

This role is primarily focused on managing driver performance, delivering excellent customer service, and ensuring the station consistently achieves its key operational KPIs.

The successful candidate will be a strong people leader who thrives in a dynamic logistics environment, prioritizes safety, and drives performance through coaching, accountability, and effective operational planning.

Key Responsibilities

1. Driver Team Leadership

• Lead, motivate, and supervise a team of delivery drivers (3PL.)

• Conduct daily briefings and route reviews to ensure clarity of expectations.

• Monitor driver performance and provide regular coaching and feedback.

2. KPI Performance Management

Drive continuous improvement and accountability to consistently achieve the following 4 key KPIs:

• First Time Delivery Success (FTDS) – Maximise successful first-attempt deliveries through route optimisation, driver coaching, and address accuracy checks.

• On Time Pick Up – Ensure all collections are completed within agreed time windows.

• Customer Complaint Rate – Minimize complaints through high service standards, proactive communication, and issue resolution.

• Parcels Per Route (PPR) – Work with Site Lead and the wider Last Mile team to optimize route productivity while maintaining service quality and safety standards.

3. Customer Service Excellence

• Champion a customer-first, every parcel culture across the delivery team.

• Investigate and resolve customer issues quickly and professionally.

• Monitor service quality and ensure company standards are upheld.

• Collaborate with customer service teams to close feedback loops and prevent recurring issues.

4. Operational & Warehouse Oversight

• Oversee daily dispatch and return processes to ensure smooth station operations.

• Ensure accurate parcel scanning, sorting, and load-out procedures.

• Report on daily KPI results to the Last Mile leadership team.

• Maintain clear communication between warehouse, drivers, and management.

5. Health, Safety & Compliance

• Promote and enforce a strong safety culture.

• Ensure compliance with all health & safety policies and driving regulations.

• Conduct safety briefings and incident investigations when required.

• Monitor vehicle and equipment standards.

• Ensure the station operates safely and efficiently at all times.

직무 내용

일상적인 창고 운영 모니터링 과정에서 발생하는 이상 상황에 신속하게 대응하고, 문제에 대한 폐쇄형(Closed-loop) 관리를 수행합니다. 관련 부서와 긴밀히 협력하여 해결 방안을 수립 및 실행하고, 문제 처리의 효율성과 정확성을 향상시킵니다.

Qui nous sommes

JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics) est la branche logistique de JD.com et l’un des principaux acteurs mondiaux des solutions supply-chain pilotées par la technologie. Forts d’une expertise avancée en automatisation, en gestion intelligente des flux et en analyse de données, nous opérons des services logistiques intégrés de bout en bout qui accompagnent les entreprises dans leur croissance et améliorent l’expérience client.

Nos réseaux couvrent l’ensemble de la chaîne logistique : gestion d’entrepôts, transport longue distance, livraison du dernier kilomètre, logistique des produits volumineux, chaîne du froid et opérations transfrontalières. Notre ambition : garantir vitesse, fiabilité et précision à chaque étape.

Notre présence internationale

JINGDONG Logistics a construit sur l’une des infrastructures logistiques les plus étendues au monde, avec plus de 3 600 entrepôts totalisant 34 millions de mètres carrés. Notre réseau international de logistique intelligente allie entrepôts hautement automatisés et solutions de transport international robustes, pour fluidifier les flux transfrontaliers.

Aujourd’hui, nous exploitons plus de 130 entrepôts (sous douane, en envoi direct ou à l'étranger) dans 23 pays et régions, à travers nos marques internationales JoyLogistics et JoyExpress — en pleine expansion pour renforcer l’empreinte logistique mondiale de JD.com.

En savoir plus sur qui nous sommes et ce que nous faisons : https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

Ce que nous offrons

Rejoindre JD Logistics, c’est contribuer activement à construire l’avenir de la supply-chain et de la logistique à l’échelle mondiale. Vous travaillerez sur des projets concrets autour des entrepôts intelligents, de la livraison autonome et des technologies innovantes qui font circuler les marchandises à travers le monde.

Nous proposons une rémunération compétitive, des locaux idéalement situés, et une culture d’entreprise centrée sur l’humain. Vous aurez l’opportunité de relever des défis stimulants, de développer vos compétences, et de faire une vraie différence dans un secteur en pleine transformation.

À propos de l’équipe

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe JD Logistics, où l’on valorise le travail d’équipe, la prise d’initiatives et l’engagement à délivrer des résultats de qualité dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant.

Job Responsibilities

• Develop, execute and optimize long-term strategic procurement plans covering European warehousing, trucking and last-mile courier services, aligning with the company's overall business development goals.

• Lead the identification, evaluation and onboarding of high-quality suppliers; deeply tap and integrate underlying trucking resources (FTL/LTL), warehousing resources and last-mile courier resources to build a comprehensive, stable and cost-competitive logistics supplier ecosystem.

• Lead complex negotiations on long-term cooperation agreements, pricing, SLAs and payment terms with core suppliers across warehousing, trucking and last-mile scenarios to achieve overall cost optimization and service quality upgrading.

• Establish and improve a systematic supplier management system, including performance evaluation, hierarchical management and incentive mechanisms, to drive continuous improvement of supplier service capabilities across all procurement scenarios.

• Monitor and conduct in-depth analysis of European logistics market trends (warehousing, trucking, last-mile), regulatory changes and industry risks; proactively adjust procurement strategies and propose effective risk prevention and control solutions.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, sales, finance and other departments to coordinate procurement resources across multiple scenarios and ensure the smooth operation of the end-to-end logistics supply chain.

Requirements

• 8-10+ years of experience in European integrated logistics procurement (covering warehousing, trucking and last-mile courier)

• Profound industry experience and in-depth insight into the European contract logistics market; extensive and high-quality local resources including underlying trucking resources, warehousing suppliers and last-mile courier service providers.

JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics) est la branche logistique de JD.com et l’un des principaux acteurs mondiaux des solutions supply-chain pilotées par la technologie. Forts d’une expertise avancée en automatisation, en gestion intelligente des flux et en analyse de données, nous opérons des services logistiques intégrés de bout en bout qui accompagnent les entreprises dans leur croissance et améliorent l’expérience client.

Nos réseaux couvrent l’ensemble de la chaîne logistique : gestion d’entrepôts, transport longue distance, livraison du dernier kilomètre, logistique des produits volumineux, chaîne du froid et opérations transfrontalières. Notre ambition : garantir vitesse, fiabilité et précision à chaque étape.

Notre présence internationale

JINGDONG Logistics a construit sur l’une des infrastructures logistiques les plus étendues au monde, avec plus de 3 600 entrepôts totalisant 34 millions de mètres carrés. Notre réseau international de logistique intelligente allie entrepôts hautement automatisés et solutions de transport international robustes, pour fluidifier les flux transfrontaliers.

Aujourd’hui, nous exploitons plus de 130 entrepôts (sous douane, en envoi direct ou à l'étranger) dans 23 pays et régions, à travers nos marques internationales JoyLogistics et JoyExpress — en pleine expansion pour renforcer l’empreinte logistique mondiale de JD.com.

En savoir plus sur qui nous sommes et ce que nous faisons : https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

Ce que nous offrons

Rejoindre JD Logistics, c’est contribuer activement à construire l’avenir de la supply-chain et de la logistique à l’échelle mondiale. Vous travaillerez sur des projets concrets autour des entrepôts intelligents, de la livraison autonome et des technologies innovantes qui font circuler les marchandises à travers le monde.

Nous proposons une rémunération compétitive, des locaux idéalement situés, et une culture d’entreprise centrée sur l’humain. Vous aurez l’opportunité de relever des défis stimulants, de développer vos compétences, et de faire une vraie différence dans un secteur en pleine transformation.

À propos de l’équipe

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe JD Logistics, où l’on valorise le travail d’équipe, la prise d’initiatives et l’engagement à délivrer des résultats de qualité dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Warehouse and Sorting center Process Planning: Responsible for theprocess planning of warehouse and sorting center for European logistics business, including data analysis, process design, working route design, equipment selection, functional area layout, etc., output CAD layout plans and ROI analysis; continuously improves logistics operation efficiency through process optimizations and reduces operating costs.

2. Automation Planning and Implementation: Familiar with Eruopean and international automated logistics technology and scenarios, combining local operational characteristics in Europe, design the selection, layout, and system integration of automated equipment, promote the connection and implementation of automated equipment with various internal system links (such as WMS、WCS、TMS), ensuring the feasibility of the technical solution.

3. Pre-sales Planning: For pre-sales projects, participate in customer communication and needs research, interpret RFP documents, independently complete process planning and technical bid documents writing, providing professional and implementable warehousing planning and automation solutions for project bidding.

4.Planning for the Standardization System Construction: Sort out and improve the layout standards of process planning, equipment selection and configuration standards, process optimization execution rules, management standards, and cross-departmental collaboration mechanisms within the European warehouses, to promote the accumulation and replication of standardized capabilities.

﻿

﻿Job Requirements:

1. Basic Requirements: Bachelor's degree or above, majors in Industrial Engineering, Logistics and supply chain management, Automation, and other related fields.

2. Language Requirement: Fluent in English, capable of using it as a working language for meetings, reports, and project communication.

3. Work Experience: More than 5 years of experience in process planning or automation planning. Familiar with the layout logic of warehousing/processing centers, operation process design and the characteristics of common logistics equipment. Those with experience in European or cross-border logistics planning are preferred.

4. Professional Skills: Possess rigorous logical thinking and data sensitivity, capable of independently completing complex scheme data analysis and ROI calculation. Proficient in using CAD for warehouse layout drawing, and master at least one data analysis tool (such as Excel, SQL, Python).

5. Soft Skills: Possess strong project coordination and cross-departmental communication skills, and be able to adapt to periodic business trips within the European region; be good at summarizing and extracting, and have the ability to quickly learn and consolidate methodologies.

Nous sommes fiers d’être un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. Toutes nos décisions en matière d’emploi sont prises sans distinction d’origine, de sexe, d’identité de genre, d’orientation sexuelle, d’âge, de situation de handicap, de religion, d’opinions ou de toute autre caractéristique sans lien avec les aptitudes professionnelles.

Job Summary:**
The Reverse Operator at JD.com, Inc. plays a critical role in managing and processing returned or exchanged products, ensuring efficient and accurate reverse logistics operations to maintain customer satisfaction and optimize inventory.

Job Responsibilities:**
* Receive, inspect, and verify returned products against original order details and return authorizations.
* Document product condition, categorize returns (e.g., damaged, defective, customer remorse), and initiate appropriate disposition processes.
* Perform quality checks and basic troubleshooting on returned electronics and other goods to determine re-sellable status or repair needs.
* Update inventory management systems with accurate return data, including product status, location, and reason for return.
* Coordinate with quality control, repair teams, and warehousing staff for further processing of returned items.
* Prepare products for return to stock, refurbishment, or disposal according to established procedures.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and safety regulations throughout the reverse logistics process.
* Identify and report recurring issues or trends in product returns to management for process improvement.
* Maintain a clean and organized work environment in the reverse logistics area.

Job Qualifications:**
* High school diploma or equivalent; associate's degree or technical certification is a plus.
* 1+ year of experience in a warehouse, logistics, or quality control environment, preferably with reverse logistics experience.
* Familiarity with product inspection and quality assessment techniques.
* Proficiency in using inventory management systems and basic computer applications.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and product handling.
* Ability to lift and move packages up to 50 lbs and stand for extended periods.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Problem-solving aptitude and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Knowledge of e-commerce operations is a plus.

Who We Are

At JD.com, also known as JINGDONG, we are building one of the world’s most trusted technology and supply chain ecosystems. What started as a bold idea in China has evolved into a NASDAQ-listed, Fortune 44 global enterprise serving over 700 million active customers. Powered by advanced logistics, innovative technology, and a commitment to integrity, JD.com operates across retail, logistics, technology, property and more, creating solutions that make everyday life smarter, faster, and more connected.

Our Global Reach

JD.com is expanding its international footprint through a digitally intelligent, cross-border supply chain and world-class logistics network, supported by platforms such as Joybuy, which brings trusted products to customers worldwide. Lead initiatives like industry research and competitor analysis, standardizing methodologies. Conduct financial training to elevate team expertise and foster sustained business-finance integration.

What We Offer

Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Job Summary**

As an Installer at JD.com, Inc., you will be responsible for the efficient and safe installation of a variety of products, ranging from home appliances and furniture to complex electronics, at customer locations. This role is crucial for ensuring customer satisfaction through professional service and accurate product setup.

Job Responsibilities**

* Safely transport and deliver products to customer homes or businesses.
* Unpack, assemble, and install a diverse range of products according to manufacturer specifications and company standards.
* Conduct pre-installation checks and post-installation testing to ensure proper functionality.
* Educate customers on product usage, basic maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Provide excellent customer service, addressing any questions or concerns professionally and courteously.
* Complete all necessary documentation, including installation reports, delivery confirmations, and customer feedback forms.
* Maintain tools, equipment, and company vehicles in good working order.
* Adhere to all safety protocols and company policies.
* Collaborate with dispatch and customer service teams to ensure timely and efficient installations.
* Identify and report any product defects or damage during the installation process.

Job Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; vocational training or certification in a relevant field (e.g., appliance repair, electronics installation) is a plus.
* Proven experience in product installation, assembly, or a related field.
* Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to read and interpret technical manuals and diagrams.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills.
* Ability to lift heavy objects and perform physical tasks repeatedly.
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
* Familiarity with basic tools and power tools.
* Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
* Flexibility to work varying schedules, including weekends and evenings, as required.

Job Summary
Oversee and coordinate inbound logistics operations to ensure efficient and accurate receipt, storage, and dispatch of goods within JD.COM INTERNATIONAL UK LTD's warehouse facility. This role involves leading a team to maintain high operational standards and adherence to company policies.

Job Responsibilities
* Supervise and train a team of inbound associates, ensuring adherence to safety protocols, company policies, and operational procedures.
* Plan, organize, and monitor the receiving, unloading, sorting, and put-away processes for all incoming shipments.
* Ensure accurate inventory management, including discrepancy resolution and data entry into the Warehouse Management System (WMS).
* Optimize inbound workflows to maximize efficiency, reduce processing times, and minimize errors.
* Collaborate with procurement, inventory, and outbound teams to ensure smooth flow of goods and resolve operational issues.
* Conduct regular performance reviews for team members and provide constructive feedback and coaching.
* Maintain accurate records of inbound activities, including daily reports on productivity, quality, and attendance.
* Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance inbound operations and overall warehouse performance.
* Ensure compliance with all health, safety, and environmental regulations within the inbound department.
* Operate and oversee the use of material handling equipment safely and efficiently.

Job Qualifications
* Proven experience (3+ years) in a supervisory role within a fast-paced logistics or warehouse environment, specifically in inbound operations.
* Strong understanding of warehouse management systems (WMS) and inventory control principles.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to motivate and develop a team.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).
* Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify trends, and implement solutions for operational improvements.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound decisions under pressure.
* Forklift certification (reach truck, counterbalance) and experience operating various material handling equipment preferred.
* Flexibility to work various shifts, including weekends and holidays, as operational needs dictate.
* Knowledge of UK health and safety regulations pertinent to warehouse operations.
* Fluency in English, both written and verbal.

We are seeking Senior Installation Engineers with a strong electrical background to play an integral part in our JoyLogistic’ s team and lead our home delivery services.

In this role, you won't just be installing high-end technology; you will be the technical backbone of our field operations, ensuring safety, precision, and excellence in every home.

About the Role

As a Senior Engineer, you are the bridge between complex electrical requirements and seamless customer delivery. You will manage high-specification installations, which may include smart home integration, EV charging points, and premium integrated appliances. All while ensuring our work complies with the latest regulations.

You will also lead, develop and mentor junior team members, and depot managers ensuring best practice, quality and regulations are followed.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead Electrical Installations: Execute and sign off on complex electrical connections and installations in domestic environments.

• Customer Excellence: Provide expert-level product demonstrations, turning a technical installation into a premium experience for the client.

• Technical Mentorship: Act as a dedicated mentor to junior installers and apprentices, conducting on-site coaching and mentoring  to elevate the team's technical skills.

• Quality Assurance: Perform spot checks and audits on installations to ensure they meet both 18th Edition standards and our own rigorous internal benchmarks.

• Compliance: Maintain accurate certification records and ensure all health and safety protocols are strictly followed by the crew.

About You:

• Qualifications: Fully qualified Electrician (e.g., NVQ Level 3, City & Guilds 2365, or equivalent).

• Regulations: Up-to-date 18th Edition (BS 7671) qualification is essential.

• Experience: Proven track record in domestic electrical work and appliance installation.

• Leadership Mindset: A natural ability to teach others and a passion for developing the next generation of engineers.

• Licensing: A clean UK driving license (experience with 3.5t vehicles is a plus).

This role is will involve regular travel to depots and customers’ homes

title: Strategic Investment
description:
Who We Are

JINGDONG Property (JD Property) is JD.com’s fast-growing infrastructure investment and asset management platform. We develop and manage logistics parks, business parks, data centres, and other essential facilities that power JD.com’s wider supply-chain ecosystem. By combining strategic investment with deep insight into merchandise and logistics flows, we support the growth of sectors including e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and beyond.

Our Global Reach

JINGDONG Property is rapidly expanding worldwide, with more than 50 overseas infrastructure projects across eight countries, including Indonesia, Vietnam, Singapore, the UK, the Netherlands, Germany, Japan, and the UAE. We are building a modern global logistics infrastructure network that strengthens JD.com’s international supply-chain ecosystem and supports broader global trade and cooperation.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://jdp.com.cn/about

What We Offer

Joining JD Property means helping build the infrastructure that keeps global commerce moving. You’ll take on meaningful challenges, learn from experienced teams, and contribute to projects that shape long-term impact. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to grow and thrive in a fast-evolving environment.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Property team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Qualifications:

The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, intelligent, and capable real estate investment professional with robust financial modeling and analytical skills, preferably with some experience in logistics real estate and/or experience in UK and other European markets.  In addition to strong technical skills, the ideal candidate should be a self-starter and entrepreneurial, can effectively multitask and propose new investment ideas.  It will be added quality if the candidate also brings some asset management, capital market, fundraising, or development experience, though it is not required.

The ideal candidate shall possess the following professional qualifications:

•
Candidates must have a BA or BS degree from an accredited institution, with preferred degrees in real estate, finance, business, accounting, economics, or related areas.

•
5 or more years of direct real estate investment experience, either within an investment management / private equity fund or real estate company, with a strong track record underwriting and executing deals (preferable logistics) in target markets.

•
Having successful investment experience in more than one coutry in UK and other European markets would be a strong plus.

•
Possess robust financial modeling skills for complex real estate projects, including development, value-add, and core-plus projects with multiple shareholders/JV partnership structures and complex capital stacks.  Candidate must be able to effectively and accurately build, alter, and update financial models to produce financial return analysis, scenario and sensitivity analysis, DCF, and multiple tiers of waterfall.

•
Have a solid understanding of macroeconomic trends, capital market conditions, and real estate fundamentals, and are able to translate that knowledge into practical underwriting assumptions and analysis of potential and existing projects.

•
Effective communication skills and cross-culture sensitivity with internal and external stakeholders of varied seniorities.

•
Have a keen interest in private and public market real estate investments, cross-border commerce, and a global perspective of economic interactions.

•
English language proficiency is a must, and professional working level Chinese language skill is desirable but not required;

•
Proficient in Microsoft Suite.

A successful candidate would also possess the following characteristics:

•
High level of integrity and dependability are absolutely required.

•
Entrepreneurial and proactive in driving preliminary acquisition work.

•
Sound judgment and independent thinking, balancing proactive problem solving and seeking collaborative input to produce results/deliverables effectively.

•
A respectful, professional, thoughtful, balanced work style that fits effectively across cultures and geographies.

•
Well-organized and self-directed individual who is disciplined in oversight of details yet possesses a “big picture” perspective.

•
Effective in engaging stakeholders, both internally as well as partners, third party firms, and industry leaders.

•
A team player who motivates peers and builds cohesive teams.

Responsibilities:

This outstanding acquisition and investment position is part of the team responsible for the growth strategies in Europe by building and managing a logistics real estate portfolio thoughtfully and strategically that aligns with the company’s long-term objectives of globalizing its business.  This position will also work closely with the management team at the corporate headquarters and across different JDP regional teams, as well as with other business units within the JD.com group.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to, the following:

•
Interact effectively with brokers, sellers, and developers to source new deals.  Develop financial models to evaluate potential deals, analyze the key risks and potential mitigants.  Propose ways to optimize returns through better operations, different tax and capital structures, exit strategies, and other business plans.

•
Research and prepare market and competitor intelligence to help with internal strategic directions.  Provide research data to update underwriting assumptions, such as absorption, markets rents, growth rates, vacancies, free rent and other concessions, TI packages, operating expenses, capital values, yields/cap rates, tax, financing, etc.

•
Assist in due diligence and transaction of new deals, including managing internal and external stakeholders and synthesizing large amounts data into a clear concise understanding of critical investment risks/drivers.  Assist in closing progress with attention to details while working within tight timeline.

•
Prepare investment memos for Investment Committee for new deals and major CapEx of existing projects, as well as presentation for potential investors.

•
Maintain effective working relationships with both internal and external stakeholders, including brokers, appraisers, bankers/lenders, financial and tax consultants, legal counsels, technical advisors, and joint venture partners.

•
Support asset management function and actively monitor and analyze project performance after closing.  Update financial models for ongoing investments such as hold/sell analysis, sensitivity analyses to provide reliable, accurate actual/forecast investment returns.  Proactively identify any upcoming material deviation from underwriting and propose solutions to senior management.

•
Provide analysis for disposition proposal and work with external stakeholders to prepare for the disposition process.  Perform distribution analysis, and facilitate distribution process after disposition.

About JD Property:

JD Property (JDP) is a subsidiary of the global e-commerce conglomerate JD.com (listed on NASDAQ and ranked 52nd among Global Fortune 100 companies with ~US$156 billion in revenue).  JDP specializes in logistics real estate investment, development, operations, and management.  JDP currently has active assets in UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Vietnam, Indonesia, and Singapore outside of its home market of mainland China, and it has plans to enter other overseas markets.  For more information about JDP, please visit https://jdp.com.cn.

Nos réseaux couvrent l’ensemble de la chaîne logistique : gestion d’entrepôts, transport longue distance, livraison du dernier kilomètre, logistique des produits volumineux, chaîne du froid et opérations transfrontalières. Notre ambition : garantir vitesse, fiabilité et précision à chaque étape.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Joining our team as a Delivery Service Provider (DSP) Manager, you will be responsible for:

- Service Provider Management: Responsible for the management of DSP service providers, KPI assessment, and relationship maintenance incl. identification and onbaording of suitable partners
- Capacity communication and coordination: Establish a close communication mechanism to coordinate capacity resources to match business needs, and ensure smooth delivery operations.
- Exception Handling: Lead the handling of various exceptions in DSP partnerships, develop solutions, and close the loop to minimize business impact.
- Compliance Management: Ensure that partnerships meet European compliance requirements and regularly review service provider qualifications and operating standards.

1.Bachelor's degree or above; approximately five years of experience in last mile delivery partnership management, with a deep understanding of partnership models and operational logic;

title: US Financial Business Partner
description:
Who We Are

At JD.com, also known as JINGDONG, we are building one of the world’s most trusted technology and supply chain ecosystems. What started as a bold idea in China has evolved into a NASDAQ-listed, Fortune 44 global enterprise serving over 700 million active customers. Powered by advanced logistics, innovative technology, and a commitment to integrity, JD.com operates across retail, logistics, technology, property and more, creating solutions that make everyday life smarter, faster, and more connected.

Our Global Reach

JD.com is expanding its international footprint through a digitally intelligent, cross-border supply chain and world-class logistics network, supported by platforms such as Joybuy, which brings trusted products to customers worldwide. Today, our teams operate across China, the U.S., U.K., Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and beyond, reaching customers in every corner of the world.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://corporate.jd.com/

What We Offer

Joining JD.com means becoming part of a company where people, innovation, and impact go hand in hand. We offer a competitive salary, a great location, and a supportive, people-first culture where your growth truly matters. With access to global projects, learning opportunities, and an inclusive environment that values every voice, you’ll have the space to shape the future with us.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JD.com team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

1. Budgeting & Forecasting:
Develop annual budgets and rolling forecasts, monitor variances, and recommend adjustments to align financial goals with business strategies. Optimize resource allocation and decompose targets to support performance achievement.
2. Business Analysis & Reporting:
Establish a business KPI framework, generate regular analytical reports, identify anomalies, and conduct root cause analysis. Propose actionable strategies to drive operational improvements and cost-efficiency.
3. Decision Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Engage with frontline operations to assess projects and design solutions. Provide financial insights for decision-making, resolve cross-departmental bottlenecks, and ensure strategic execution.
4. Risk Management & Compliance:
Identify risks (e.g., revenue inflation, delivery fraud) and implement preventive controls. Monitor cash flow, receivables, and payables to mitigate bad debt and liquidity risks.
5. Data Systems & Tool Development:
Design data models and automation tools (e.g., BI dashboards) to streamline financial processes. Enhance data accuracy and analytical efficiency for precision in business operations.
6. Special Projects & Capability Building:
Lead initiatives like industry research and competitor analysis, standardizing methodologies. Conduct financial training to elevate team expertise and foster sustained business-finance integration.

• Develop, execute and optimize long-term strategic procurement plans covering European warehousing, trucking and last-mile courier services, aligning with the company's overall business development goals.

• Lead the identification, evaluation and onboarding of high-quality suppliers; deeply tap and integrate underlying trucking resources (FTL/LTL), warehousing resources and last-mile courier resources to build a comprehensive, stable and cost-competitive logistics supplier ecosystem.

• Monitor and conduct in-depth analysis of European logistics market trends (warehousing, trucking, last-mile), regulatory changes and industry risks; proactively adjust procurement strategies and propose effective risk prevention and control solutions.

Requirements

• 8-10+ years of experience in European integrated logistics procurement (covering warehousing, trucking and last-mile courier)

• Profound industry experience and in-depth insight into the European contract logistics market; extensive and high-quality local resources including underlying trucking resources, warehousing suppliers and last-mile courier service providers.

• Proven track record of successful strategic procurement planning and implementation across multiple logistics scenarios, with significant achievements in cost optimization, supplier ecosystem construction; excellent complex negotiation and contract management capabilities.

• Strong ability to adapt to fast-paced and high-pressure work environments; excellent problem-solving, decision-making and crisis management capabilities.

title: Transportation Specialist
description:
Qui nous sommes

JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics) est la branche logistique de JD.com et l’un des principaux acteurs mondiaux des solutions supply-chain pilotées par la technologie. Forts d’une expertise avancée en automatisation, en gestion intelligente des flux et en analyse de données, nous opérons des services logistiques intégrés de bout en bout qui accompagnent les entreprises dans leur croissance et améliorent l’expérience client.

Nos réseaux couvrent l’ensemble de la chaîne logistique : gestion d’entrepôts, transport longue distance, livraison du dernier kilomètre, logistique des produits volumineux, chaîne du froid et opérations transfrontalières. Notre ambition : garantir vitesse, fiabilité et précision à chaque étape.

Notre présence internationale

JINGDONG Logistics a construit sur l’une des infrastructures logistiques les plus étendues au monde, avec plus de 3 600 entrepôts totalisant 34 millions de mètres carrés. Notre réseau international de logistique intelligente allie entrepôts hautement automatisés et solutions de transport international robustes, pour fluidifier les flux transfrontaliers.

Aujourd’hui, nous exploitons plus de 130 entrepôts (sous douane, en envoi direct ou à l'étranger) dans 23 pays et régions, à travers nos marques internationales JoyLogistics et JoyExpress — en pleine expansion pour renforcer l’empreinte logistique mondiale de JD.com.

En savoir plus sur qui nous sommes et ce que nous faisons : https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

Ce que nous offrons

Rejoindre JD Logistics, c’est contribuer activement à construire l’avenir de la supply-chain et de la logistique à l’échelle mondiale. Vous travaillerez sur des projets concrets autour des entrepôts intelligents, de la livraison autonome et des technologies innovantes qui font circuler les marchandises à travers le monde.

Nous proposons une rémunération compétitive, des locaux idéalement situés, et une culture d’entreprise centrée sur l’humain. Vous aurez l’opportunité de relever des défis stimulants, de développer vos compétences, et de faire une vraie différence dans un secteur en pleine transformation.

À propos de l’équipe

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe JD Logistics, où l’on valorise le travail d’équipe, la prise d’initiatives et l’engagement à délivrer des résultats de qualité dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant.

1. Planification et optimisation des processus de transport : planifier les stratégies de transport en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, en optimisant les processus de bout en bout, y compris la collecte, le tri, le transit et la livraison des marchandises. Rationaliser les itinéraires afin de minimiser les retours, établir des procédures opérationnelles standardisées, améliorer l'efficacité et réduire les coûts.
2. Gestion des transporteurs et des ressources : évaluer et sélectionner des transporteurs de haute qualité, mettre en œuvre des systèmes d'évaluation des performances et superviser les opérations quotidiennes afin de remédier aux anomalies. Intégrer et allouer les ressources de transport, développer de nouveaux canaux, optimiser les itinéraires et les configurations de capacité, et garantir la qualité et la ponctualité du service.
3. Surveillance des opérations et résolution des problèmes : surveiller les indicateurs de transport en temps réel (coût, efficacité, profits/pertes) et mettre en place des alertes de risque pour traiter rapidement les anomalies. Analyser les données opérationnelles afin d'identifier les possibilités d'optimisation, élaborer des plans d'amélioration et garantir la stabilité des opérations de transport.
4. Service client et collaboration : s'aligner sur les besoins des clients, gérer les cycles de service de bout en bout et résoudre les plaintes/réclamations. Coordonner les équipes internes et les partenaires externes afin de garantir des processus de transport fluides, améliorant ainsi la satisfaction et l'expérience des clients.

5. Gestion d'équipe et renforcement des capacités : définir les objectifs de l'équipe, déléguer les tâches et fournir des formations/conseils. Mettre en place un système de développement des talents afin d'améliorer les compétences professionnelles et la conscience du service des membres de l'équipe, garantissant ainsi une exécution efficace et une croissance durable des opérations de transport.

JINGDONG Logistics s'engage à favoriser un environnement de travail inclusif, dans lequel chacun et chacune peut s’épanouir pleinement. Nous sommes fiers d’être un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. Toutes nos décisions en matière d’emploi sont prises sans distinction d’origine, de sexe, d’identité de genre, d’orientation sexuelle, d’âge, de situation de handicap, de religion, d’opinions ou de toute autre caractéristique sans lien avec les aptitudes professionnelles.

Prêt(e) à postuler ?

Passez à l’étape suivante de votre carrière, postulez dès maintenant et découvrez les opportunités que nous avons à offrir.

JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics) est la branche logistique de JD.com et l’un des principaux acteurs mondiaux des solutions supply-chain pilotées par la technologie. Forts d’une expertise avancée en automatisation, en gestion intelligente des flux et en analyse de données, nous opérons des services logistiques intégrés de bout en bout qui accompagnent les entreprises dans leur croissance et améliorent l’expérience client.

Nos réseaux couvrent l’ensemble de la chaîne logistique : gestion d’entrepôts, transport longue distance, livraison du dernier kilomètre, logistique des produits volumineux, chaîne du froid et opérations transfrontalières. Notre ambition : garantir vitesse, fiabilité et précision à chaque étape.

Notre présence internationale

JINGDONG Logistics a construit sur l’une des infrastructures logistiques les plus étendues au monde, avec plus de 3 600 entrepôts totalisant 34 millions de mètres carrés. Nous proposons une rémunération compétitive, des locaux idéalement situés, et une culture d’entreprise centrée sur l’humain. Vous aurez l’opportunité de relever des défis stimulants, de développer vos compétences, et de faire une vraie différence dans un secteur en pleine transformation.

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe JD Logistics, où l’on valorise le travail d’équipe, la prise d’initiatives et l’engagement à délivrer des résultats de qualité dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant.

title: (Head of) Finance Business Partner
description:

Engage with frontline operations to assess projects and design solutions. Provide financial insights for decision-making, resolve cross-departmental bottlenecks, and ensure strategic execution.

Identify risks (e.g., revenue inflation, delivery fraud) and implement preventive controls. Monitor cash flow, receivables, and payables to mitigate bad debt and liquidity risks.

Design data models and automation tools (e.g., BI dashboards) to streamline financial processes. Enhance data accuracy and analytical efficiency for precision in business operations.

Lead initiatives like industry research and competitor analysis, standardizing methodologies. Conduct financial training to elevate team expertise and foster sustained business-finance integration.

title: Loss Prevention & Security Manager
description:
Job Description

1. Develop and update a comprehensive safety management system in accordance with local laws, regulations, and company policies; promote the implementation of safety procedures in operations and ensure control measures are enforced. Formulate emergency response plans and measures for various operational incidents, establish emergency response teams and safety committees, and ensure safe business operations.

2. Based on business development needs, build and improve the loss-prevention management system; use data management, investigations and audits, process improvements, and security-company management to prevent company asset losses.

3. Investigate all types of abnormal incidents, produce investigation reports, define corrective actions for identified risks and vulnerabilities, and verify the results of these corrective measures.

4. Perform regular maintenance and servicing of all on-site safety equipment and surveillance systems.

5. Collect and organize national/state laws and regulations on safety and loss prevention, and carry out corresponding work in compliance with these statutory requirements.

6. Maintain regular contact with fire departments and police agencies, keep close cooperative relationships, and possess the ability to handle emergency incidents.

7. Assess operational risks, devise effective response strategies, protect company personnel and tangible and intangible assets, and provide comprehensive support for sustainable business development.

8. Be responsible for the safety management of the self-operated transport fleet and drivers; establish and implement a management system for the self-operated transport fleet to reduce the incidence of transport accidents.

9. Manage last-mile delivery safety to decrease accident rates and merchandise loss during final delivery.

Requirements

1. Veterans given priority. Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in Chinese or English; possess keen judgment and decisive decision-making ability.

2. Work experience requirements: background in safety management, loss prevention, risk management, inspection, or related fields.

3. Work experience requirements: minimum five years of work experience in chain retail or e-commerce industries, including at least three years of team-management experience.

4. Must be honest and upright, enthusiastic about work, able to work under high pressure; familiar with local basic laws, regulations, and criminal-law knowledge; understand online business process operations; possess investigation and interview skills; capable of communicating and coordinating with government agencies to handle emergency incidents.

title: Loss Prevention & Security Manager-Me
description:
Job Description

1. Develop and update a comprehensive safety management system in accordance with local laws, regulations, and company policies; promote the implementation of safety procedures in operations and ensure control measures are enforced. Formulate emergency response plans and measures for various operational incidents, establish emergency response teams and safety committees, and ensure safe business operations.

2. Based on business development needs, build and improve the loss-prevention management system; use data management, investigations and audits, process improvements, and security-company management to prevent company asset losses.

3. Investigate all types of abnormal incidents, produce investigation reports, define corrective actions for identified risks and vulnerabilities, and verify the results of these corrective measures.

4. Perform regular maintenance and servicing of all on-site safety equipment and surveillance systems.

5. Collect and organize national/state laws and regulations on safety and loss prevention, and carry out corresponding work in compliance with these statutory requirements.

6. Maintain regular contact with fire departments and police agencies, keep close cooperative relationships, and possess the ability to handle emergency incidents.

7. Assess operational risks, devise effective response strategies, protect company personnel and tangible and intangible assets, and provide comprehensive support for sustainable business development.

8. Be responsible for the safety management of the self-operated transport fleet and drivers; establish and implement a management system for the self-operated transport fleet to reduce the incidence of transport accidents.

9. Manage last-mile delivery safety to decrease accident rates and merchandise loss during final delivery.

Requirements

1. Veterans given priority. Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in Chinese or English; possess keen judgment and decisive decision-making ability.

2. Work experience requirements: background in safety management, loss prevention, risk management, inspection, or related fields.

3. Work experience requirements: minimum five years of work experience in chain retail or e-commerce industries, including at least three years of team-management experience.

4. Must be honest and upright, enthusiastic about work, able to work under high pressure; familiar with local basic laws, regulations, and criminal-law knowledge; understand online business process operations; possess investigation and interview skills; capable of communicating and coordinating with government agencies to handle emergency incidents.

title: Warehouse Associate
description:
1. Receiving Shipments

Receive incoming shipments and ensure accuracy of quantities and product types.

Check for visible damages and report any discrepancies or issues to the supervisor.

Ensure goods are unloaded safely and moved to the correct storage or staging areas.

2. Shipment Processing & Coordination

Prepare and organize outgoing shipments according to schedule.

Verify shipment details such as destination, route, and load accuracy.

Coordinate with the transport or dispatch team to ensure timely departures.

Load and unload vehicles efficiently using appropriate equipment (e.g., forklift, pallet jack).

Ensure shipments are handled with care to prevent damage.

Maintain accurate records of all loaded and unloaded shipments.

Move and organize materials in the warehouse to support shipment flow.

Ensure all items are stored in their designated locations for easy retrieval.

Assist in stock checks or physical verification related to shipping activities.

Support tracking of inbound and outbound shipments to ensure accuracy.

Maintain shipment records for reference and audits.

Follow all warehouse safety guidelines and operating procedures.

Keep work areas clean, organized, and free from hazards.

Report equipment faults or safety concerns promptly.

Coordinate with logistics, transport, and warehouse control teams for smooth operations.

Communicate effectively regarding delays, damages, or shipment-related issues.

description:

title: Internal Audit Manager
description:
【Job Responsibilities】

【Job Requirements】
Job Summary

As an internal auditor, you'll provide an independent guarantee that an organisation's risk management, governance and control processes are operating effectively. You'll work within businesses and organisations to monitor and evaluate how well risks are being managed, how the business is running and if internal processes are working.

Auditing also includes a consulting service, advising management on how to improve their systems and processes, and in turn providing evidence to present to stakeholders. Meanwhile, you'll also consider factors such as reputation, growth, environmental impact, treatment of employees and ethics.

Key Responsibilities

•Plan and execute audit engagements, including data analysis and testing.

•Review and analyze financial statements and supporting documentation.

•Evaluate internal control systems and ensure adherence to applicable laws.

•Perform risk assessments and internal control evaluations and detect discrepancies.

•Identify and investigate potentially fraudulent activities or financial irregularities.

•Prepare and present audit reports to the Management of auditted area.

•Collaborate with external auditors or legal service providers during statutory audits and regulatory compliance assessments.

•Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and execute remedial actions.

•Stay updated with the latest industry regulations and best practices in internal auditing.

Requirements

•Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or a related field.

•Professional certification, such as AICPA, CIA (Certified Internal Auditor) or CA (Chartered Accountant).

•6+ years of experience in internal auditing or related financial roles, and Big 4 experiences prefered.

•Strong understanding of US GAAP accounting standards, taxation and regulatory requirements.

•Proficiency in using data analysis tools and MS Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook).

•Experience in developing and executing audit plans and evaluating internal control systems.

•Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.

•Excellent analytical, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

•Ability to work independently or in a team or lead a team.

•Excellent verbal and written communication skills on both Chinese and English.

•Strong ethical standards and a commitment to maintaining confidentiality.

•Ability to adapt to changing regulatory environments and industry practices

title: Logistics Officer
description:
【Job Responsibilities】

【Job Requirements】
About JD.com

JD.com (NASDAQ: JD and HKEX: 9618), also known as JINGDONG, has evolved from a pioneering e-commerce platform into a leading technology and service provider with supply chain at its core. Renowned for its supply chain innovation and excellence, JD.com has expanded into sectors including retail, technology, logistics, healthcare, and more, aiming to transform traditional business models with cutting-edge digital solutions.
Know more about us:https://corporate.jd.com/

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Logistics Specialist to manage customs documentation, clearance, and compliance for our import/export operations in the UAE and GCC region. This role will be pivotal in ensuring seamless shipment processing, regulatory adherence, and client satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

Prepare, verify, and submit accurate customs documentation (invoices, air waybills, packing lists, HS codes) in compliance with UAE customs regulations and international trade standards.
Use JDL and other customs platforms to manage documentation and ensure adherence to UAE, GCC, and international trade laws, including bonded zones and exemptions.
Handle import/export clearance for air, sea, and land shipments (FCL, LCL, break bulk, B2B, B2C), coordinating with customs authorities, free zones (e.g., JAFZA), and mainland UAE.
Calculate and process customs duties/taxes accurately, ensuring timely payments and maintaining reconciled financial records.
Prepare invoices for duties, taxes, and clearance fees; coordinate with finance to resolve disputes and ensure collections.
Act as the main client contact for customs procedures, duty obligations, and shipment updates, liaising with officials, freight forwarders, and vendors.
Monitor shipments from port to warehouse, manage GCC cross-border logistics, and coordinate truck allocation and tracking.

Qualifications & Skills:

Bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain management, or a related field.
Proven experience in logistics, customs clearance, and trade compliance in the UAE.
Strong knowledge of UAE customs regulations, GCC trade laws, and HS code classification.
Proficiency in JDL and other customs/billing systems.
Excellent communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple shipments simultaneously.

Roles and Responsibilities :
- Have a pulse of the business unit and constantly think about how to improve the effectiveness of the business unit - by looking at teams, structure, and processes.
- Work closely with leadership and teams to improve work relationships, build morale/culture and increase productivity and retention.
- Review and analyze people-related data to identify trends and recommend solutions to improve performance, retention, and employee experience.
- Interpret and present data & analytics in a way that provides meaningful insight to the business.
- Offer HR policy guidance and advise. Ensure seamless execution of all People Practice programs and processes within the BU.
- Administer org-wide programs like performance reviews, rewards and recognition etc.
- Take active part in the design of the HR Strategic Business Plan and manage the execution of the plan.
- Create annual engagement program with extended reach to member's families, Alumni etc.
- Effectively manage the HR Operations activities like MIS, reports, payroll inputs, etc.
- Being updated with the best HR practices across industry and create thought leadership in the HR space by implementing innovative programs

【About JD.com】

JD.com (NASDAQ: JD and HKEX: 9618), also known as JINGDONG, has evolved from a pioneering e-commerce platform into a leading technology and service provider with supply chain at its core. Renowned for its supply chain innovation and excellence, JD.com has expanded into sectors including retail, technology, logistics, healthcare, and more, aiming to transform traditional business models with cutting-edge digital solutions. Ranked 47th on the Fortune Global 500, JD.com is China’s largest retailer by revenue. In 2023, JD.com reported revenues of US$152.8 billion and served approximately 600 million active customers.

【Our International Business】

We are dedicated to building a digitally intelligent, cross-border supply chain and global retail infrastructure. Leveraging our global supply chain capabilities, JD.com continues to expand in markets where our competitive strengths shine. Currently, JD.com operates globally, with business activities in countries such as China, the U.S., U.K., Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and many others, reaching customers in every corner of the world.
